summary: Iteration 10: Mobile responsiveness testing completed successfully. All mobile navigation and responsive layout features are working correctly.

issues: Charts show console warnings about width/height -1 on mobile (non-blocking, UI renders correctly)

passed_tests: Mobile sidebar navigation opens via hamburger menu button (data-testid='mobile-menu-btn') using JS click
Mobile sidebar (Sheet component) displays correctly with all navigation items
Clicking nav items in mobile sidebar closes sidebar and navigates to correct page
Sidebar auto-closes on route change via useEffect on location.pathname
Desktop sidebar (1920px width) is always visible - aside element with hidden lg:flex classes
Hamburger menu button is hidden on desktop viewport (lg: breakpoint)
Login page renders correctly on mobile (375px) - centered card, proper padding
Login flow works on both mobile and desktop viewports
POS Dashboard cards stack vertically on mobile (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4)
Create Order page (POSMain) - 2-column menu grid on mobile, order summary stacks below (flex-col lg:flex-row)
Quick POS page - categories scroll horizontally (overflow-x-auto), items 2-column grid on mobile
Quick POS page - cart panel stacks below on mobile (flex-col lg:flex-row)
Wallet page - period buttons wrap properly on mobile (flex-wrap)
Wallet page - summary cards display in 2-column grid on mobile (grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4)
Analytics page - controls wrap properly on mobile (flex-col sm:flex-row)
Analytics page - stats cards stack on mobile (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4)
Navigation links (Dashboard, Create Order, Quick POS, Analytics, Kitchen Display, Wallet) all work via mobile sidebar
critical_code_review_comments: Recharts console warning about -1 width/height on initial render (minor, non-blocking)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile responsiveness is fully functional. Key implementation details: (1) POSLayout uses Shadcn Sheet component for mobile sidebar with Radix Portal, (2) Hamburger button click requires JS evaluate for React state change, (3) Desktop breakpoint is lg (1024px+), (4) Auto-close on route change via useEffect on location.pathname. All tested data-testid selectors: mobile-menu-btn, mobile-sidebar, nav-dashboard, nav-create-order, nav-quick-pos, nav-analytics, nav-kitchen-display, nav-wallet.

mocked_apis.note: Twilio SMS/WhatsApp, Razorpay payments, Swiggy/Zomato integrations are MOCKED

mobile_sidebar_navigation.details: Sheet component from Shadcn opens/closes correctly. Uses Radix Portal. Hamburger button (data-testid='mobile-menu-btn') visible on mobile, hidden on desktop (lg:hidden class).

mobile_sidebar_links.details: All nav links work via mobile sidebar. Links close sidebar on click via useEffect watching location.pathname.

desktop_sidebar.details: Desktop sidebar always visible (hidden lg:flex). Full navigation visible without hamburger.

pos_dashboard_mobile.details: Cards stack vertically on mobile using grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4.

create_order_mobile.details: POSMain uses flex-col lg:flex-row. Menu grid shows 2 columns on mobile (grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-6). Order summary stacks below.

quick_pos_mobile.details: Categories scroll horizontally (overflow-x-auto). Items grid 2 columns on mobile. Cart panel stacks below using flex-col lg:flex-row. max-h-[45vh] on mobile for cart.

wallet_mobile.details: Period buttons wrap using flex-wrap. Cards in 2-column grid (grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4).

analytics_mobile.details: Header controls wrap using flex-col sm:flex-row. Stats cards use responsive grid.

login_flow.details: Login works on both mobile (375px) and desktop (1920px) viewports.

playwright_testing_notes.hamburger_click: Must use JavaScript evaluate: document.querySelector('[data-testid="mobile-menu-btn"]').click() - Playwright force=True click does NOT trigger React state change due to Radix Portal event delegation.
playwright_testing_notes.mobile_nav_links: Similarly use JS evaluate for clicking nav links inside mobile-sidebar.
